implementation.appearanceSource: Uses O05F feature-control state and its appearanceCandidate/refresh. Adds no flags fetch, timer, or persistent cache; retains O05F's project-namespaced and separate feature/appearance caches.
implementation.brandGates: oorva_brand is the parent. branding_runtime is effective only when oorva_brand is true. Parent OFF retains the legacy theme and leaves candidate copy unapplied; runtime OFF or unusable appearance uses the bundled Oorva candidate only when the parent is ON.
implementation.validationAndPreload: Validates candidates with O02 strict schema/contrast checks, allowing only the locally bundled Manrope heading face in addition to Inter. Optional referenced image preload must complete before candidate publication; invalid schema or preload failure falls back without blocking feature controls.
implementation.theme: Builds and deeply freezes a complete theme snapshot before context publication. OS light/dark wins; appearance defaultTheme applies when OS scheme is unavailable. Existing useTheme/makeStyles exports and typography variant names are retained.
implementation.fonts: Registers the two bundled Manrope heading faces; Inter remains the body and unavailable-Manrope fallback. App startup proceeds after the configured font set loads/errors or a 1000ms readiness deadline.

cases: UI-CACHE-01 atomic preloaded theme publish, immutability, stable identity
UI-CACHE-02 provider-independent and parent-OFF legacy fallback; compatibility/offline candidate fallback
UI-CACHE-03 unknown schema and failed logo preload fall back without changing OFF controls or dirty drafts
UI-CACHE-04 OS-first mode precedence, dirty-draft preservation, Manrope-to-Inter fallback
